task: Seed skill bundle companion files into the workspace once per skill at AgentWorkspaceToolkit.get_tools build time, gated by script-execution tool + workspaceScriptBridge + jobs sandbox mode, with insert-if-absent writes, a seed ledger, size/count ceilings, deterministic ordering shared with SkillTool, and per-workspace concurrency safety.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches tool layer (AgentWorkspaceToolkit.get_tools), service layer (new seeder service, SkillService ordering fix, workspace_script_bridge gate composition), repository layer (new insert-if-absent write op on AgentWorkspaceFileRepository), and DB/migration layer (new seed-ledger table or JSONB column). Also fixes a shared ordering gap in SkillRepository.get_by_ids that SkillTool itself depends on — core shared utility touched, feeding both chat and workflow execution paths simultaneously.

Two genuinely novel pieces with zero in-repo precedent: (1) insert-if-absent write — the only existing primitive (_upsert_workspace_file_content/_reference) does the opposite (revive-on-upsert) and cannot be parameter-tweaked without risking existing callers; (2) per-workspace serialization/row-locking — no FOR UPDATE pattern exists anywhere in this codebase, only an unrelated LeaderLockContext advisory-lock primitive of unproven fit. Combined with a DB schema change (new table/column + Alembic migration), this is high-risk, hard-to-roll-back territory.
Tool + Service + Repository + DB/migration layers, with a schema/migration requirement (seed ledger) — DB schema changes always bump this per calibration guidance.

Most decisions are pre-made (D3/D4/D4a/D7/D24) but no architecture-spec document exists in-repo to cross-check them, and the ticket explicitly leaves the seed-ledger storage shape (new table vs JSON column) as an open 'decide in this story' question — a TBD-style gap on a load-bearing schema decision.

New seeder service + tests, new repository method + tests, Alembic migration, SkillRepository/SkillService ordering fix + tests, reserved-path validation reuse, two new DynamicConfig ceiling settings + accessor functions + tests, and a bundle-preview endpoint field — estimated 11-15 files touched across tool/service/repository/migration/config directories.
